description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pathagama, Kuruvita D/S Division, Rathnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620277
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (Parcel Nos. 25, 28, 95, 96) with detailed information about land ownership, extent, encumbrances, and servitude rights. The content focuses entirely on land property matters without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land related administrative matters.
